observations: Photo 0 shows a black PlayStation 4 console with the PS logo visible on the front.
A black DualShock 4 controller is placed in front of the console.
The console has a textured surface and a vertical seam on the right side, typical of PS4 Pro models.
The console appears to be in used condition with some minor scuffs and dust.
No visible damage to the console or controller.
No CD games are visible in the photo.

claims.claim: I bring to you the pro version of PlayStation 4 (ps4 pro)
claims.evidence: No photo shows this clearly enough to read.
No CD games are visible in photo 0. The console's disc tray is not shown, and no games are visible on the console or in the tray.

claims.claim: Neatly used, never opened or repaired, no overheating, all ports working. Comes with the original pads and the UK receipt.
claims.evidence: No photo shows this; it is the seller's word only.

risks.risk: The console may not be a PS4 Pro model, but a standard PS4.
risks.proof: A clear photo showing the model label on the back or bottom of the console.
risks.if_unproven: Priced as a standard PS4, not PS4 Pro.

risks.risk: CD games are not included or are not functional.
risks.proof: A photo showing the disc tray open with a game disc inside, or a video of the game loading.
risks.if_unproven: Priced as no games included, or as games not working.

risks.risk: The console may have internal damage or be non-functional.
risks.proof: A video showing the console powering on, booting up, and running a game.

proof_requests: Photo of the model label on the back or bottom of the console.
Photo of the disc tray with a game disc inside.
Video of the console powering on and running a game.
response.reason: The item is known from the photos. What they cannot prove is priced at its worst case until the proof asked for below arrives.
